findings.reader: A tight, well-scoped news report: it answers the reader's account question first (P007), makes the vetting→scoped-grant→offline-monitoring mechanism concrete (P005–P006), keeps attribution and uncertainty intact (P008), and ends with three specific headline-reading checks. No failure families present; explain-back and a fresh transfer scenario both succeed.
findings.facts: All material claims — the September 17 beta, purpose, Standard/High-risk grant structure, offline-monitoring shift with 30-day retention, and teams-first availability — are supported by the supplied Anthropic announcement excerpts with attribution and limitations preserved; the article correctly withholds any claim that the controls are proven effective.
